cmd: echo '### deals-sync-trigger'; systemctl cat deals-sync-trigger.service 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'ExecStart|WorkingDirectory|User='; echo '### finrep-trigger'; systemctl cat finrep-trigger.service 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'ExecStart|WorkingDirectory|User='; echo '### cashtrigger'; systemctl cat cashtrigger.service 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'ExecStart|WorkingDirectory'; echo '### ХТО ТРИМАЄ ПОРТИ (шлях процесу)'; for p in 8787 8788; do pid=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk -v P=":$p" '$4 ~ P' | grep -oE 'pid=[0-9]+' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); [ -n "$pid" ] && printf '  %s -> pid %s -> %s\n' "$p" "$pid" "$(readlink -f /proc/$pid/cwd) | $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline)"; done; echo '### ЧИ Є deals_trigger НА ДИСКУ ВЗАГАЛІ'; find /root -maxdepth 3 -name 'deals_trigger.py' -o -maxdepth 3 -name 'trigger.py' 2>/dev/null | head -6; echo '### ЧИ Є authcheck.py ДЕ-НЕБУДЬ'; find /root -maxdepth 3 -name 'authcheck.py' 2>/dev/null | head -6
